Visualizations for data investigations and challenging beliefs and expectations. They are meant to probe the data to generate additional questions. AI is used to generate the visualization code, but all data used originate from the validated audited pipeline so no figures are fabricated.

## Figure cards

Each card asks one question and answers it with one figure. Search, or click a tag to see every card that carries it; open a card to explore its figure.
